notes: Governmental funds are modified cash basis (basis set to cash; no liabilities, fund balance = cash); business-type activities are accrual (net position measure). Governmental receipts/disbursements/transfers from p5 Total Governmental Funds column. Business-type from p7 proprietary statement total column; no single total printed so receipts = operating revenues 392,973 + interest income 69, disbursements = operating expenses 401,185 + interest expense 28,882. Statement of cash flows (p8-9) is accrual proprietary on a cash-basis report so proprietary set to null (Water fund only on p8; total on p9). Balance sheet is the government-wide Statement of Net Position Total column (p1; combines modified cash governmental and accrual business-type). Detail: General fund recorded from the Combining Statement of General Fund Departments (p12-13, more detailed; department columns only, Total column not double counted); General fund budgetary schedule p10 not recorded to avoid double counting (budget columns are by function and not comparable to departments). Street fund from budget schedule p11; Debt Service fund has no detail schedule. Printed 'Contactual services' typo kept in label. Cemetery (4,890) and Park (89,189) capital outlay lines take category capital outlay so the detail ties to the p5 Capital outlay function (94,079); other Cemetery lines stay health/welfare per the cemetery rule although p5 includes them in Public works (71,840 = Yard 24,345 + Cemetery 52,385 - 4,890).
